package com.mindarray.util;

public class InputValidator {
    
    public static ValidationResult validateUserId(String userId) {
        if (userId == null || userId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return ValidationResult.error("User ID cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!userId.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid user ID format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static ValidationResult validateEmail(String email) {
        if (email == null || !email.matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid email format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static class ValidationResult {
        public final boolean valid;
        public final String error;
        
        private ValidationResult(boolean valid, String error) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.error = error;
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult success() {
            return new ValidationResult(true, null);
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult error(String message) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, message);
        }
    }
}
```

Implement a caching layer for UserService to reduce database calls.
The cache should:
- Store user objects in memory
- Expire entries after 5 minutes
- Return cached data for repeated requests with same userId

<thinking>
Requirements: In-memory cache with TTL
Implementation: Use ConcurrentHashMap with timestamp tracking
Check: Validate expiration on each retrieval
</thinking>

```java
// SEARCH
public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        return repository.findById(id);
    }
}

// REPLACE
public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}
```

Implement a caching layer for UserService to reduce database calls.
The cache should:
- Store user objects in memory
- Expire entries after 5 minutes
- Return cached data for repeated requests with same userId

<thinking>
Requirements: In-memory cache with TTL
Implementation: Use ConcurrentHashMap with timestamp tracking
Check: Validate expiration on each retrieval
</thinking>

```java
// SEARCH
public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        return repository.findById(id);
    }
}

// REPLACE
public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}
```

Multiple services have duplicate validation logic for user IDs, emails, and URLs.
Extract this into a reusable InputValidator class to follow DRY principle.

<thinking>
Goal: Extract duplicate validation logic
Pattern: Utility class with static validation methods
Benefits: Reusability, single source of truth, easier testing
</thinking>

```java
// PLAIN CODE
package com.mindarray.util;

public class InputValidator {
    
    public static ValidationResult validateUserId(String userId) {
        if (userId == null || userId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return ValidationResult.error("User ID cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!userId.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid user ID format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static ValidationResult validateEmail(String email) {
        if (email == null || !email.matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid email format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static class ValidationResult {
        public final boolean valid;
        public final String error;
        
        private ValidationResult(boolean valid, String error) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.error = error;
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult success() {
            return new ValidationResult(true, null);
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult error(String message) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, message);
        }
    }
}
```

public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}

            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}

    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

public class InputValidator {
    
    public static ValidationResult validateUserId(String userId) {
        if (userId == null || userId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return ValidationResult.error("User ID cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!userId.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid user ID format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static ValidationResult validateEmail(String email) {
        if (email == null || !email.matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid email format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static class ValidationResult {
        public final boolean valid;
        public final String error;
        
        private ValidationResult(boolean valid, String error) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.error = error;
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult success() {
            return new ValidationResult(true, null);
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult error(String message) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, message);
        }
    }
}
```

Implement a caching layer for UserService to reduce database calls.
The cache should:
- Store user objects in memory
- Expire entries after 5 minutes
- Return cached data for repeated requests with same userId

<thinking>
Requirements: In-memory cache with TTL
Implementation: Use ConcurrentHashMap with timestamp tracking
Check: Validate expiration on each retrieval
</thinking>

    private final UserRepository repository;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        return repository.findById(id);
    }
}

// REPLACE
public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}
```

public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}

            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid user ID format");
        }

        if (email == null || !email.matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid email format");

        return ValidationResult.success();
    }

        public final boolean valid;

        private ValidationResult(boolean valid, String error) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.error = error;
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult success() {
            return new ValidationResult(true, null);
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult error(String message) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, message);
        }
    }
}

public class UserService {

    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}

package com.mindarray.util;

public class InputValidator {
    
    public static ValidationResult validateUserId(String userId) {
        if (userId == null || userId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return ValidationResult.error("User ID cannot be empty");
        }
        if (!userId.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid user ID format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static ValidationResult validateEmail(String email) {
        if (email == null || !email.matches("^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@(.+)$")) {
            return ValidationResult.error("Invalid email format");
        }
        return ValidationResult.success();
    }
    
    public static class ValidationResult {
        public final boolean valid;
        public final String error;
        
        private ValidationResult(boolean valid, String error) {
            this.valid = valid;
            this.error = error;
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult success() {
            return new ValidationResult(true, null);
        }
        
        public static ValidationResult error(String message) {
            return new ValidationResult(false, message);
        }
    }
}

    private String uuid;

    @Override
    public void start(Promise<Void> promise) throws Exception {

            vertx.eventBus().<JsonObject>localConsumer(EVENT_DATASTORE_STATUS, message -> {
                var event = message.body();

                if (uuid.equalsIgnoreCase(event.getString(RemoteEventProcessor.REMOTE_EVENT_PROCESSOR_UUID))) {

                    eventEngine.setStatus(event.getString(STATUS).equalsIgnoreCase(STATUS_UP));
                }
            });

            eventEngine = new DatastoreEngine().setEventType(config().getString(EventBusConstants.EVENT_TYPE))
                    .setPersistEventOffset(true).setStatus(false).setPause(true).setLogger(LOGGER).setEventHandler(this::send).start(vertx, promise);

        } catch (Exception exception) {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

            } else {
                vertx.eventBus().send(EVENT_REMOTE, event.put(EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_HA_DATASTORE_SECONDARY_SYNC));
                LOGGER.trace("datastore event sent to primary app");
            }
        }
    }

    public void stop(Promise<Void> promise) throws Exception {
        try {
            eventEngine.stop(vertx, promise);
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }
}

public class UserService {

    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {

        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;

        User user = repository.findById(id);

        final User user;

            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}

The cache should:

- Expire entries after 5 minutes
- Return cached data for repeated requests with same userId

// REPLACE
public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}

public class UserService {
    private final UserRepository repository;
    private final Map<String, CacheEntry> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    
    public User getUser(String id) {
        CacheEntry entry = cache.get(id);
        if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired()) {
            return entry.user;
        }
        User user = repository.findById(id);
        if (user != null) {
            cache.put(id, new CacheEntry(user));
        }
        return user;
    }
    
    private static class CacheEntry {
        final User user;
        final long timestamp;
        
        CacheEntry(User user) {
            this.user = user;
            this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        
        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() - timestamp > CACHE_TTL_MS;
        }
    }
}
